method: Compare current primary publisher pages for relevance, format, source practice, dates and service handoffs. Use existing provider snapshots only with their original dates and geography.

benchmarks.name: Emerhub
benchmarks.observed: Country and service categories, practical explainers, updated articles and contact paths.
benchmarks.apply: Build clear question-led guides and a useful next step into an existing service.
benchmarks.limit: No comparable traffic or revenue dataset was available.
benchmarks.observedAuthor: Colin Young on the reviewed guide; page displays publication and update dates.

benchmarks.name: InCorp / Cekindo
benchmarks.observed: The reviewed PT PMA guide includes key takeaways, overview/comparison tables, FAQs and an editorial attribution.
benchmarks.apply: Use decision aids and precise applicability, checking regulatory claims against official instruments.
benchmarks.limit: The publisher is a competitor, not the legal source of truth.

benchmarks.name: Seven Stones Indonesia
benchmarks.observed: The October 15 article is attributed to Terje Nilsen and connects an identified rule to practical business situations.
benchmarks.apply: Use dated change explainers with named affected audiences and exact primary references.
benchmarks.limit: Its legal interpretations were not adopted as verified facts.

benchmarks.name: DDTCNews
benchmarks.observed: Topic hub, dated news, explanations, reference resources and tools.
benchmarks.apply: Maintain a watchlist and distinguish news, explanation, glossary and reference content.
benchmarks.limit: Do not republish its reporting or treat every story as relevant to a villa owner.

benchmarks.name: PwC Indonesia TaxFlash
benchmarks.observed: Dated numbered bulletins, defined issues and references to legal instruments.
benchmarks.apply: Record publication date, effective date, audience, practical action and primary citation.
benchmarks.limit: A format benchmark, not evidence of rankings or a claim that PwC is a direct local bookkeeping competitor.

benchmarks.name: Bali Accounting Service (B.A.S.)
benchmarks.observed: Separate accounting, tax and legal service areas, consultation paths and contact details.
benchmarks.apply: Make scopes and the next enquiry step easy to distinguish.
benchmarks.limit: No current independent traffic, ranking trend or revenue comparison was established.

benchmarks.name: Business Hub Asia
benchmarks.observed: Service categories and a resource area containing blogs, FAQs and downloads.
benchmarks.apply: Connect a useful informational question to the correct service and location context.
benchmarks.limit: A broader service company; its published scale claims were not independently verified.

existingDemandEvidence.limitations: Provider estimates, not site visits or exact Bali long-tail demand. Do not sum overlapping variants. The October 28 refresh records HTTP 402 and obtained no fresh volumes.
